title: An Improved Exponent for Products of Differences over Arbitrary Finite Fields
summary: Murphy and Petridis proved that, for subsets $A$ of an arbitrary finite field $\F_q$, the condition $\abs A>q^{2/3-δ}$ implies $\abs{(A-A)(A-A)}>q/2$ whenever $δ \frac q2 \] for an absolute constant $C>0$.
